Add regression coverage for bounds persistence, high DPI, and monitor/work-area changes.

comment.body:
Thanks for the clear resize/move/close/reopen steps and the 3840x2160 display detail. The report is on PowerToys 0.80.1 and does not include scaling or whether the applet reopens on the same monitor.
Please provide:
1. Whether this still reproduces on the latest stable release.
2. If it does, the affected display scaling percentage, monitor count/primary display, and whether any dock or monitor change occurs before reopening.
This distinguishes failure to save bounds from DPI/work-area restoration.

actions.label: Design fix
actions.note: Approve a focused, evidence-gated fork-side investigation of window-bound persistence after current behavior is confirmed. This does not write upstream.
